name: dirs8
description: Design 9.2: the touch stick is held fully deflected in each of the 8 directions for 1 s (60 steps) in turn, east, south-east, south, ... clockwise on screen (y grows downwards), and the cycle repeats. stick is the finger's displacement in CSS pixels from where the touch began; the game clamps it to the 42 px stick radius, so the diagonals [42,42] come out as the unit vector.
